phase: F4 — Workspace Shell V2 renderer skeleton in @fc/ui-system

responsibilities: Renders header + (sidebar + main) only when state==='ready'
Visible diagnostic on error — no silent fallback

renders: ungrouped items appended in a null-group bucket
WorkspaceSidebarV2Component.label_resolution: label.label || label.fallback || id (no i18n-key invention, no hardcoded copy)

DosSurfaceRendererComponent.f4_state: Structural slot only. resolved() === false ⇒ visible 'Missing component: <componentKey>' diagnostic.
DosSurfaceRendererComponent.f5_plan: Inject COMPONENT_MAP from @fc/foundation-module and resolve componentKey → component class.

WorkspaceRuntimeService.fallback_payload: NONE — error state surfaces status + message to UI

tokens.FC_RUNTIME_CONFIG: InjectionToken<FcRuntimeConfig> — value provided by app bootstrap from /config.json (no build-time baking)

build_proof.verbatim_module_syntax: compliant (type-only imports split where TS 5.4 inline-type was rejected)

doctrine_alignment.no_static_nav: Sidebar renders ONLY runtime.shell.nav.{groups,items}. Empty ⇒ visible 'no nav'.
doctrine_alignment.no_fallback_surface: Surface renderer shows missing-key diagnostic when component not registered.
doctrine_alignment.no_hardcoded_routes: ShellAction.navigate paths come from runtime DB rows; renderer never invents a path.
doctrine_alignment.no_db_reads_from_angular: WorkspaceRuntimeService uses fetch only; no pg/knex/kysely.
doctrine_alignment.no_domain_components: Only structural shell + diagnostic renderer. Foundation module wires into COMPONENT_MAP in F5.
doctrine_alignment.no_OIDC: Service uses fetch(credentials: 'include'); session attachment lands in F4.5/F5.

remaining_for_F5: OIDC session middleware → inject x-fc-tenant-id / x-fc-user-id from cookie
DosSurfaceRenderer → resolve componentKey via injected COMPONENT_MAP
Angular app: add /workspace-v2 route mounting WorkspaceShellV2Component, provide FC_RUNTIME_CONFIG from /config.json
